audit.summary: The active release performs bilinear center-stencil depth resizing instead of complete-patch averaging and missingness testing. Exact sparse/depth examples reverse inclusion in both directions, without establishing a robot-performance effect.
limitations: Preliminary AI assessment; independent human scientific adjudication remains pending.
Analytic witnesses and static release checks do not remeasure the published benchmark results.

proposition.claim: The paper computes patch-mean depth and skips the \(3\)-D feature when over \(90\%\) of the patch is masked; the release downsamples depth and mask bilinearly.

repair.content: For aligned patches compute \(n_P=\sum M_p\) and \(u_P=\sum M_pD_p\). Retain when \(n_P>0\) and \(10n_P\ge A\), and use \(u_P/n_P\). This restores the declared local rule for the stated partition; changed checkpoints/performance require separate evaluation.
